About the Scholarship

RADMEP+ is a multidisciplinary European master on how radiation affects microelectronics and photonics — a key specialisation for space, nuclear and high-radiation environments. Application rounds have opened in mid-October and closed on 9 February in the last two cycles, so the 2027-2029 round is expected to follow the same rhythm.

ApplyOfficial application page ↗

RADMEP+ is a multidisciplinary European master on how radiation affects microelectronics and photonics — a key specialisation for space, nuclear and high-radiation environments. Application rounds have opened in mid-October and closed on 9 February in the last two cycles, so the 2027-2029 round is expected to follow the same rhythm.

Programme Highlights

  • Unique specialisation across radiation, microelectronics and photonics technologies
  • Study across Finland, Belgium and France with an industry-relevant thesis
  • Consistent 9 February closing date across recent application rounds
  • Graduates feed space agencies, CERN-type labs, semiconductor and photonics companies

Who Should Apply

Bachelor's degrees in microelectronics, photonics, physics or related engineering fields are expected, alongside English proficiency documentation.

Funding and Costs

Scholarships for the best applicants: participation costs covered plus a monthly allowance, as offered in each application round.

Deadline and How to Apply

Apply through the RADMEP application form once the round opens in October 2026, and target the early-February deadline with certified documents ready. Key deadline information: 9 February 2027 (expected — the previous two rounds closed 9 February); applications open mid-October 2026.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About RADMEP+ Consortium

The RADMEP+ consortium delivers the European master in Radiation and its Effects on Microelectronics and Photonics Technologies, with university partners in Belgium, Finland and France and strong ties to radiation-test facilities.

Official website: https://master-radmep.org

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 9 February 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
